profile.headline: Software Engineer at Enterprise Fleet Management
profile.summary:
Background in Salesforce administration,  sales, client relations, mentoring, training and merchandising.

* Experienced in customer relations and sales
* Enthusiastic, with keen attention to detail

Specialties: Inventory management,  marketing,  policy analysis, relationship building, and client loyalty.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Salesforce Software Engineer. Assist with bringing updates and releases to factilite business in execution of Salesforce platform

positions.title: Product Administrator
positions.description:
Product Administrator for Salesforce.com 
Work with Engineering staff to implement, maintain, and support integration of Salesforce platform
Support account maintenance, reporting and dashboards, as well as work flow tasks
Recommend and present solutions as well as interpret and implement recommendations regarding salesforce platform as necessary

positions.title: Senior Vehicle Adminstration Coordinator
positions.description:
Assisted team with vehicle order processing
Placed and verified orders for accuracy
Partnered with other teams for payment, licensing, and titling
Supported four fleet groups including Philadelphia, PA, Baltimore, MD, Toronto, ON and Calgary, AB 
Promoted communication and transparency to lead to superior customer satisfaction ratings

positions.title: Internet Manager
positions.description:
Responsible for daily management of leads, client relations, and follow up.  
Increased retention and sales by 5-7% in department while adding vendors and new lead sources.  
Streamlined and standardized lead providers to clearly communicate information.

positions.title: Accessories and Delivery Manager
positions.description:
As team leader, trained and mentored a team of employees, 
Assisted hiring & training over seven new sales consultants
Recruited by former supervisor to create, staff and manage new team.
Created point of sale materials for increased accessory sales.
Streamlined communications between sales, service, and parts departments by helping create a common spreadsheet and database of pricing and products.
Increased Customer and Sales satisfaction scores by over 20 percent, resulting in a top score from the manufacturer.
Recruited and streamlined vendor relations; communicated with several companies to give dealer greatest efficiency and pricing. 
Ensured highest customer satisfaction of customers by timely, thorough delivery and follow up.

positions.title: Internet & Scion Sales Manager
positions.description:
Implemented review and training of Toyota Signature dealer initiatives, a customer centered and driven program; increased profitability by 10 percent, and efficiency by 25 percent
Revised follow-up procedures, increased follow up by 50 percent and retention of customer base by 10 percent
Taught Partners In Education class with Rockwood School District concentrating on air pollution and hybrid technology, educating classes of 125 per semester on the benefits of hybrids and alternative energy 
Spearheaded revision of internet sales policies, increased productivity and profitability by 10 percent
As Scion Manager, promoted brand through marketing, inventory control, and allocation management increasing sales by 25 percent, becoming number one in the six state region.
Toyota “Mobility Champion,” aiding with vehicle conversions for differently-abled individuals; corporate liaison, responsible for validating rebate for consumer once vehicle was completed
Achieved record sales for store in 2003, 2005, and 2008 up 10 percent from each previous year
Excelled in a company wide product presentation in 2004 and 2005, required distilling information into a 10 minute presentation, placed second out of fifteen
Completed certified Toyota, Scion, internet, and phone training
Built and maintained client relationships, having a loyal customer base of over 700 clients with customer satisfaction survey scores averaging near 100 percent
Mentored, supervised new employees, training over 12 new hires
Performed vehicle appraisals determining fair market value for vehicles
